sources.title: Foundation Models for Robotics: Vision-Language-Action (VLA)
sources.snippet: I would argue that language understanding is a necessary component for a general-purpose robotics foundation model. However, it is an open question on whether the LLM has to be the main component in the model. For example, we may one day build powerful vision models for robotics, and add a small language component.
